Area: Nursing professions.

Welcome to your new place of work.

Urs Wildbolz offers you for our project "Visit - Spital Zollikerberg Home" on 1 January. September 2026 or by agreement a 60-100% position as

Dipl. Nursing professional / Dipl. Nursing specialist - Visit - Spital Zollikerberg at home

If you too want to make a difference in people’s lives, these are your tasks:

• Care and care of somatically acute patients in the emergency department and then at home in their private environment

• Clinical assessment of the situation on site and advice on health promotion issues

• Independent implementation of the nursing process also in situations of rapid changes

• Installation and instruction of telemedical equipment

• Collaboration in an interprofessional treatment team

• Willingness to provide flexible support at further stations within the department as needed

Become part of our new offer for patients under the name “Visit – Spital Zollikerberg Home”. The project "Visit" is led by the Clinic for Internal Medicine with further education status A, which is a central and important service center of the hospital with over 300 inpatients, over 20,000 emergencies and more than 450 patients cared for in the interdisciplinary intensive care unit per year. Further interesting information about our project "Visit" can be found HERE

In our 360° tour, get a first impression of your new place of work.

To make you feel comfortable with us, many benefits are waiting for you. Just to name a few:

• Ecobonus of up to CHF 650 per year

• Free use of the fitness room on the site

• Generous financial and time support for further training

• Cross-shifts into other areas, the development into a team leader or a specialization - even across several companies

All amenities for employees can be found
here . If you also want to be the best version of yourself, you will find the possibilities with us.

This convinces us:

• Completed training as a Dipl. Nurse/Dipl. Nursing professional

• High social and professional skills as well as organisational skills

• Flexible, open, creative and curious personality

• Category B driving licence

More information can be found in Urs Wildbolz, Stv. Klinikleiter Innere Medizin, T 044 397 22 94. Get to know your new supervisor in the following interview: Interview - please click here

Please apply via our online tool.

We would like to fill this position with direct applications, without the support of recruitment consultancies. Thank you in advance for your understanding.

About the Zollikerberg hospital #LI-PZ1
We stand for a comprehensive range of services and strong cooperation partners. With a public service mandate and 173 beds, the Zollikerberg Hospital contributes to the optimal medical care of the greater Zurich area. Every year, more than 11,000 inpatients and 75,000 outpatients in all insurance classes can feel comfortable and in good hands. Our broadly based primary care includes internal medicine, gynecology and obstetrics with neonatology, general surgery, an interdisciplinary emergency center and orthopedics with specialized spinal surgery.
